description: Store an already-computed diff for one file of a build bundle against a base commit (protocol v0.2 item 6, POST /coord/builds/:build_ref/diff — the parser has no GET for this path; a deployed function ships no git object database, so tascan-agent/deployer.js computes the diff text with its own persistent worktree and this route only validates + stores it via coord_set_artifact_diff). build_sha256 must equal the artifact's own stored sha256 or the call is refused; storing a diff replaces that file's stored full content with the diff going forward. There is currently no REST route that reads a stored diff back (GET /builds/:build_ref and /builds/:build_ref/file do not surface it) — this tool only writes one. Requires agent:dispatch.

base_ref.description: The commit-ish the diff was computed against (1-200 chars).

base_sha256.description: Optional 64-hex sha256 of the file at base_ref.

build_ref.description: sha256:<64 hex> (or the bare 64 hex) of the build the diff is about.

build_sha256.description: 64-hex sha256 of the file at build_ref/path — must match the stored artifact's own sha256.

path.description: Repo-relative path from the build manifest (tascan_get_build).

text.description: The already-computed diff text (up to 262144 characters). This tool never computes a diff itself.

truncated.description: True if text is itself a truncated diff.

name: tascan_get_build_diff
